Renew a person's simulated subscription for another period, as the store would. Webhooks and
analytics follow as for a store's event. When the person has several, name the product, or choose in
a terminal.

Usage:
  voidhash sandbox renew [person] [product] [flags]

Arguments:
  person   The person's distinct id, email or id
  product  The product bought, by slug, name or id, when they have several

Flags:
  -h, --help               Show help for this command
      --json               Print the API objects as JSON, for scripts
      --project <project>  Project to act on: its id, slug, organization/slug or name (default: this
                           directory's project, then your default project)

Global flags:
  -d, --debug              Print each request and full error detail to standard error
      --no-color           Print without colors (also when NO_COLOR is set)
      --profile <profile>  Use a named config profile: its settings override the base config
                           (default: VOIDHASH_PROFILE)

Examples:
  voidhash sandbox renew kim@example.com
  voidhash sandbox renew user-42 pro-monthly --json
